<think>
The compilation error arises from Error Prone’s CheckReturnValue enforcing that the result of LoadingCache.get must be used, which in Caffeine 3.x is annotated accordingly. Previously, calling cache.get(1) for side-effects was acceptable, but now the return value must be consumed. The minimal, compliant fix is to assign the result to a local variable (commonly named unused), as suggested by Error Prone. This preserves existing behavior and ensures the code compiles without altering method signatures or broader logic. We will update the loop to store the result in a local variable.
</think>

      cache.get(1);
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
